name: Outlaw Tools v0.13.1
body:
# Outlaw Tools v0.13.1

Public downloads for Outlaw Tools by Orbital Outlaws. Mining Scanner is the first complete module in the wider companion app.

Product home: https://www.orbitaloutlaws.tv/

Source repository: private (PattrnData/Outlaw-Tools)

# Outlaw Tools v0.13.1

## Star Citizen 4.10.3 reference data

- Refresh ships, FPS equipment, crafting products, Blueprints, missions and mining references from current 4.10.3 LIVE extraction inputs. Provider-declared family or unknown versions remain explicit.
- Prevent an older Blueprint/mission runtime cache from masking a newer downloaded reference pair. Valid newer caches and offline fallback remain supported; player records are retained.
- Complete automatic data publication for Blueprint, mission and mining updates alongside ships, equipment and crafting. Compatible data updates continue to activate on the next launch.

## Downloads

- Windows installer and Linux x86_64 archive, with SHA-256 checksums. Microsoft Store delivery follows certification. Android remains a separate release.
